kind: read-only source provenance and catalogue audit; deterministic replay of archived code and policies
write_boundary: this directory only; original inputs and canonical manuscript unchanged
no_calls: No network model calls, no credential lookup, no paper4 changes
wording_count_definition: For each final mission text, manually annotate at most one exact representative span for each of six service concepts (safety/C2, Remote-ID, video, energy, Wi-Fi pressure, mobility). Count occupied concept slots. Record local-authority language separately. This is a reproducible description of the final text, not a count or sequence of historical editing operations. Retain both lexicons' substring matches independently of this annotation.
pair_check: Compare records 1-24 with records 25-48 on gold_cost_profile, guards, family_mix and cost_weights. Pairing is a present-file equality check, not proof of historical generation order or annotation independence.
scaling_replay: Copy the saved code and inputs; redirect RESULT_DIR into this directory; reproduce all archived K=6,18,36,60 rows and K=60 direct-variant rows with the same cached policies. Do not generate or add variants.
behavior_signature: At each K, group variants by identical acceptance and, when accepted, loss rounded to 12 decimals over every archived mission x archetype x seed context. This is finite-grid behavior equivalence for audit, not a global equivalence theorem. Candidate expansion ordering is outside this equivalence definition.
claims: Report all methods and both nominal catalogue size and finite-grid behavior classes. Do not infer physical execution, action duration, intensity effects or parameter calibration from names alone.
history: Source locations and saved hashes prove the evaluated implementation. File order and current timestamps do not prove selection-before-evaluation, frozen gold, lack of post-observation tuning, or human annotation independence.
